name: climate-lien-score
description: Climate Lien Score — monorepo task runner. `make` is unavailable on Windows, so every project task is an npm script here.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f config/docker-compose.yml --project-directory . down -v && npm run db:up
scripts.lint:backend: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check --config pyproject.toml app ../db/migrations && node scripts/py.mjs -m black --check --config pyproject.toml app ../db/migrations
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.format:backend: node scripts/py.mjs -m black --config pyproject.toml app ../db/migrations && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check --fix --config pyproject.toml app ../db/migrations
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:backend:cov && npm run test:frontend
